import FormalConjecturesUtil

namespace DiophantineTuple

variable {R : Type*} [Semiring R]

def IsDiophantineTuple (s : Finset R) : Prop :=
  (∀ x ∈ s, x ≠ 0) ∧
  ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, x ≠ y → IsSquare (x * y + 1)

abbrev IsIntegralDiophantineTuple (s : Finset ℕ) : Prop := IsDiophantineTuple (R := ℕ) s

theorem fermat_4_tuple : IsIntegralDiophantineTuple {1, 3, 8, 120} := by
  refine ⟨by decide, ?_⟩
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, forall_eq_or_imp, forall_eq]
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩ <;> intro h
  all_goals first
    | exact absurd rfl h
    | exact ⟨2, rfl⟩ | exact ⟨3, rfl⟩ | exact ⟨11, rfl⟩
    | exact ⟨5, rfl⟩ | exact ⟨19, rfl⟩ | exact ⟨31, rfl⟩

end DiophantineTuple

import FormalConjecturesUtil

open ContDiff Set InnerProductSpace MeasureTheory EuclideanGeometry
open scoped Laplacian

namespace DeGiorgi

variable {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]

structure IsBoundedSolution (u : ℝ^n → ℝ) : Prop where
  regular : ContDiff ℝ 2 u
  bounded : ∃ C, ∀ x, |u x| ≤ C
  solution : ∀ x, (Δ u x) + u x - (u x) ^ 3 = 0

def HasPositiveDeriv (u : ℝ^n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, 0 < lineDeriv ℝ u x (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1)

def HasHyperplaneLevelSets (u : ℝ^n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ y ∈ range u, ∃ S : AffineSubspace ℝ (ℝ^n),
    u⁻¹' {y} = S ∧ Module.finrank ℝ S.direction = n - 1

def DeGiorgi_conclusion (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] : Prop :=
  ∀ u : ℝ^n → ℝ, (IsBoundedSolution u ∧ HasPositiveDeriv u) → HasHyperplaneLevelSets u

theorem DeGiorgi_one : (DeGiorgi_conclusion 1) := by
  intro u ⟨_, hpos⟩
  set e : ℝ^1 := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 with he
  have hx : ∀ x : ℝ^1, x = (x 0) • e := by
    intro x; ext i; fin_cases i; simp [he]
  have hg : StrictMono (fun t : ℝ => u (t • e)) := by
    apply strictMono_of_deriv_pos
    intro t
    have h1 := hpos (t • e)
    unfold lineDeriv at h1
    have h2 : deriv (fun s : ℝ => u (s • e)) t = deriv (fun s : ℝ => u (t • e + s • e)) 0 := by
      have h3 : (fun s : ℝ => u (t • e + s • e)) = (fun s : ℝ => u ((t + s) • e)) := by
        ext s; simp [add_smul]
      rw [h3]
      have h4 := deriv_comp_const_add (f := fun s : ℝ => u (s • e)) (a := t) (x := 0)
      simp only [add_zero] at h4
      exact h4.symm
    rw [h2]; exact h1
  have hinj : Function.Injective u := by
    intro a b hab
    rw [hx a, hx b] at hab ⊢
    rw [hg.injective hab]
  intro y ⟨x, hxy⟩
  refine ⟨AffineSubspace.mk' x ⊥, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext z
    simp only [mem_preimage, mem_singleton_iff, SetLike.mem_coe, AffineSubspace.mem_mk',
      Submodule.mem_bot, vsub_eq_zero_iff_eq]
    constructor
    · intro h; exact hinj (h.trans hxy.symm)
    · rintro rfl; exact hxy
  · simp

end DeGiorgi
